name: docneural
description: Deployable site for the docneural corpus: batch Emacs ox-html exporter (scripts/) emits .export/graph.json + docs/SLUG.html, and this Vite+Svelte shell mounts the docneural-ui theme (../docneural-ui, formerly synapt) against that data. Powered by the org-docs package (~/org-docs), which owns the corpus and the id: link engine.
